description: The question a call site cannot ask. An entry that colors nothing and a correct one come to the same silence at the call, so `nothrow check` holds every entry the way the chain holds it — against the same export surface, and against the package the *declaration* ships in — and names four of the ways one reaches nothing: a key no symbol has, a subpath the package does not publish, a key whose symbol ships in the package that declared it rather than the one that re-exported it, and, apart from the rest because it is inert rather than wrong, a package this project does not hold.

names: publishes no symbol at this key
nothing of `uninstalled` is in this project
5 entries checked. 3 reach nothing; 1 names a package this project does not hold.
